focus: Fixes for the build 2 review: MapParents-count dirty check, occupied-tile HashSets, generatedMaxLevel, PatchOperationAdd; plus About.xml deps
diffSource: since build 2 (2026-10-06T22:20:51Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: About.xml hard-depends on Entad Framework and Titan Framework, which no file in the mod uses and which have no download link
findings.detail: modDependencies now lists SaintWacko.EntadFramework and saintwacko.TitanFramework (About/About.xml:17-24). A search of the whole mod finds them only in About.xml and the description; no Source, Defs or Patches file uses either. Neither entry has a steamWorkshopUrl or downloadUrl, both exist only as workspace mods here, and Titan Framework is inactive in the current modlist. Players would get a missing-dependency warning with no way to resolve it. Drop the two modDependencies entries and keep only the loadAfter lines (which cause no cycle) until the frameworks are actually used, or add their Workshop URLs once published.

findings.title: Map-parent count dirty check misses an add and a remove in the same frame
findings.detail: WorldComponentUpdate compares only MapParents.Count, so a site expiring on one tile while another map parent appears elsewhere in the same frame leaves the icon layer stale until the next count change. A settlement replaced by a destroyed settlement on the same tile is harmless because the blocked set does not change. A rare, cosmetic edge; the corpus offers no precedent.

checked: WorldObjectsHolder.MapParents is a List<MapParent>, so .Count in WorldComponentUpdate is cheap and correct (WorldObjectsHolder.cs:59)

Generate's occupied HashSet covers every world object on the layer, as the removed AnyWorldObjectAt check in Eligible did, so placement is unchanged and no longer quadratic
